sources.UN WPP 2024: UN DESA, World Population Prospects 2024, total population, medium variant (2025 values are projections)
sources.UN National Accounts: UN Statistics Division, National Accounts Main Aggregates Database (UNdata), GDP at current prices in US$
sources.DGBAS Taiwan: Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics (DGBAS), Taiwan, Principal Figures, nominal GDP in US$; Open Government Data License, version 1.0
sources.method: GDP: newest year in the UN National Accounts (Taiwan: DGBAS, same year); GDP per capita = that GDP / UN WPP population of the same year
